original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_UBB_FPGA for the exact UBB FPGA instance and active configuration, distinguishing FPGA junction telemetry from an adjacent board probe, with matching identity, reading and state across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The FPGA/board owner identifies the FPGA device, board position, active image/build and sensor source and provides operating-condition limits; automation captures read-only evidence without reprogramming the FPGA or executing the AMDGPU annotation.
manual_activity: The FPGA/board owner identifies the exact device and active image, defines whether the value is die or board temperature, confirms any GPU relation, and approves condition-specific limits. No FPGA configuration change is authorized.
required_inputs: UBB revision and exact FPGA vendor/part/instance/board position
Active FPGA image/bitstream build, function and operating mode
Sensor source as FPGA internal diode, external probe, board proxy or derived value
Any owner-approved AMDGPU relationship or explicit non-relationship
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping
Units, scale, calibration, tolerance, sample/freshness and unavailable semantics
Ranges/thresholds by FPGA utilization, rail voltage, workload, cooling and ambient
Same-target identity, BMC/SDR/FPGA revisions, secret-safe collectors and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1881 and exclude the duplicate BF3 Web workflow
Verify FPGA device and active image read-only before applying limits
Do not infer AMDGPU ownership or execute parenthesized annotation text
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List before filters and capture Web
Do not reprogram/reset FPGA, reload drivers, start workload, alter rails/fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on device/image mismatch, stale/invalid value, FPGA fault, unsafe temperature or path disagreement; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact source/variant, duplicate isolation and FPGA device/image identity
Collect approved passive FPGA inventory and operating state
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact FPGA and Web evidence
Compare identity/value/state/freshness with passive FPGA rail/utilization/fan/SEL context
Perform no FPGA programming, driver/control action, BF3 substitution or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve FPGA instance, active image/build and sensor source
Define any AMDGPU relationship and acceptable operating modes
Review cross-path evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The exact query is incomplete because it lacks IB, full Sensor List and Web, truncates SDR and exposes credentials; it cannot identify device/image or sensing source. `(AMDGPU)` is annotation only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner identity approval, use complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, exact sensor and Web capture plus passive FPGA image/utilization/rail context.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES FPGA INSTANCE, ACTIVE-IMAGE, SENSOR-SOURCE AND THERMAL-CRITERIA PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the BMC sensor to a specific FPGA part/board position and active image, then capture synchronized management views and passive utilization/rail/cooling context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds configuration identity because FPGA power and thermal limits can vary by bitstream and operating mode.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: TEMP_BF3_Chip and generic GPU telemetry cannot establish the UBB FPGA sensor or its acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An external board probe may lag FPGA junction changes, while different bitstreams can materially alter dynamic power; a versionless static value can therefore mask an image-specific thermal issue.

project_override_considerations: If multiple FPGAs or redundant images exist, the required instance/image matrix must be explicit. If the sensor is shared or aggregated, document contributors and worst-case rule.
expected_evidence: FPGA part/instance/board position and active image/build inventory
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact result
Reading/state/unit/freshness with FPGA mode/utilization, rails, cooling, ambient and limits
BMC Web plus passive FPGA fault/SEL evidence
Same-target proof, status, hashes and annotation-handling audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1881 consistently names TEMP_UBB_FPGA. Device/image and AMDGPU semantics are missing inputs; the same-code BF3 row is a distinct source variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only FPGA temperature check is identifiable after owner-supplied device, image and limit data under ED-36.

review_improvement: Isolates BF3, binds temperature to an exact FPGA and active image, and distinguishes internal junction telemetry from an external board proxy before applying limits.
independent_technical_reasoning: FPGA thermal behavior is configuration-dependent: logic utilization, transceiver activity and rail loading vary with the active bitstream. A sensor name alone cannot show whether a value is the FPGA die or a nearby probe, so device, image and sensing-source provenance are required for valid acceptance.
